caption: The drawing depicts several outlined garment pattern pieces, drawn in black ink or pencil on an off-white or cream-colored sheet. Each piece is labeled with a letter or combination of letters in capital print: A, B, C-2, CI-2. The pieces vary in shape, including curved, rectangular, and irregular outlines. The largest pieces are labeled B-2 and C-2, with B-2 having a significant curve, while C-2 is more rectangular with a curved top. Piece A is smaller and more irregular in shape, marked with diagonal hatching on one side and labeled "CENTER BACK CUT ON FOLD." A small triangular piece adjacent to C-2 is labeled CI-2. The labels and additional handwritten text describe the assembly instructions and placement of each pattern piece, indicating points where they join together using symbols like Δ and ΔΔΔ and marking sewing or trimming lines with dotted lines. A scale indicating “1/8” is located at the lower right near piece C-2. The center and lower part of the sheet contains a block of neatly printed instructions and explanations for each labeled part, corresponding to the letter designations on the patterns. The overall composition is organized, with pattern pieces and descriptions spaced out evenly, and the entire content framed by a single rectangular border line near the edges of the paper.
title: Coat (Pattern)
